$comment: Z Clear — pre-import compliance assistant and illustrative estimator. Synthetic samples only. No duty, VAT, fee or legal requirement is invented. Estimates refuse unless external VERIFIED tariff data matches; SAMPLE figures carry a do-not-pay-or-file label. Customs happens in ASYCUDA World.

assistant.scope: Importer-only case lookup; another importer or staff member gets 404.

estimate.scope: Pure computation. Refuses unless a VERIFIED rule matches; SAMPLE rules require COMPLIANCE_SAMPLE_MODE=true.

prompts.text: Confirm with your agency: Identity copy.
Check that the value you recorded (K 1,850,000.00) matches your documents. Ask your agency if you are unsure.

sampleAssistantResponse.notice: These are questions to confirm with your agency, not legal advice or a ZRA requirement. Z Clear does not decide what customs requires or assess any amount; declarations and decisions happen in ASYCUDA World.

sampleRefusalResponse.notice: Illustrative estimate only. Z Clear does not assess duty, VAT or fees, decide customs value or file declarations. Customs amounts are decided in ASYCUDA World. Do not pay or file on this figure.
